# ThinkViva

> Expert 1-on-1 online tutoring for Nigerian diaspora families in the UK, Canada, USA and Australia. Qualified Nigerian tutors for Maths, English, Science and Languages (Kindergarten to Grade 9 (JS3). Matched in 24 hours.)

## About

ThinkViva connects diaspora families worldwide with vetted Nigerian tutors for personalised online sessions via Zoom or Google Meet. We serve children from Kindergarten through Grade 9 (equivalent to Junior Secondary 3 in Nigeria).

## Services

- **Bright Start**: 1 session/week, one subject (Maths, English or Science), for early learners
- **Rising Stars**: 2 sessions/week, English and Maths, with monthly progress reports
- **Academic Achievers**: 3 sessions/week, English, Maths and Science, with exam preparation
- **Success Squad**: 1 session/week, any subject, flexible scheduling

## Subjects

- Mathematics
- English Language
- Basic Science
- Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa (Local Languages)
